metadata.title: Dried Fish and Red Beans Curry
metadata.description:
Dried fish and red beans curry is an awesome combination of rustic earthy ingredients.  Dried fish with red beans is a fabulous combination as a curry and is delicious. 

It's cooked in many different ways in the entire Northeastern region of India by many different tribes.
